name: Teen Haunted House Volunteers
org: City of Alameda Recreation and Parks
city: Alameda, CA (Veterans Building and South Shore Mall)
what_you_do: You design and build haunted rooms, props and special effects for the Teen Haunted House. You also act as a scare actor on haunted house nights.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school teens in grades 6 to 12. No experience is needed.
pay_detail: Volunteer. You can earn community service hours.
deadline_text: Registration for the 21st annual haunted house closed September 20, 2026. Dates for next year are not posted on the program page.
how_to_apply: Sign up online on the city registration page. Go to the meetings. Finish your scene prep. Work at least two event nights. Help clean up after.
notes: Meetings are at the Veterans Building, 2203 Central Ave. The haunted house is at South Shore Mall. Questions: call 510-747-7529 or 510-747-7575, or email arpd@alamedaca.gov. The program page does not give event dates or a fee.
